reason: I have one product and I am not selling yet, so 9 900 FCFA every month is more than my internet bundle. The free plan already covers my one page, and I still confirm each payment by hand, which is what I do in WhatsApp today anyway.
objection: Paying every month before I have made a single sale, and I would also have to open a SasPay account when my buyers already pay me by mobile money.
would_change_my_mind: A small plan around 2 000 to 3 000 FCFA a month, or paying only after my first sales come in, with automatic payment confirmation so I stop checking SMS.
